newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks flat at noon, seen range-bounded.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks flat at noon, seen range-bounded.

text.p: Pakistani stocks were flat at midsession on Wednesday in thin trading and dealers said the market might trade in a narrow range on lack of support from major investors.
"The market is very quiet at the moment," dealer Zaina Nowsherwan of BMA Capital Management said. Major players were unsure of the market's direction, she added.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 7.04 points 0.46 percent, to 1,552.45 at 0720 GMT. Shell Pakistan rose 5.0 rupees to 241 rupees and PTCL 0.75 to 26.
